risk_note: RV2 by path (tools/agent, tools/ops). Review tooling only, no money moves (FU-REVIEW-RUBRIC-TRUSTED; D10-2961 / D10-2976 / D10-2996; ops/approvals.yaml ids 184, 185, 188, 215). The trusted spec-test review prompt gets two sections — companion test tasks (test-change with no implementation paths: red-first does not apply, the tests are judged by whether they catch a wrong implementation) and the exemption confirmation round — and its scope text follows the validator as merged by CT-06zzzzzzzf. The wrapper writes `Task kind: companion test task …` from the trusted ledger, and `--confirm-round <baseline commit>` (spec-test only, refused for every other type as a separate check) writes the added / changed red_exempt, red_exempt_outside, renames and expected_values entries between that baseline ledger and the trusted ledger now; a missing or unusable baseline refuses the call (exit 2, round returned). A confirmation round is marked in meta, carries no ordinary incremental context and is never the baseline of a later ordinary review. The S1 rule of the prompt says how an unconfirmed exemption is judged. Third-class gate change: merge under ops/approvals.yaml id 16 after the orchestrator checks the diff.

reviews.note: Three Codex money rounds. r1 (full) fail, three S1: the confirmation round gave no trusted-ledger delta (codex-run.sh:1393; orchestrator D10-3211 took a baseline argument, rule tests added under approvals 215); a confirmation round could become the baseline of a later ordinary review (:1394); the prompt's S1 rule conflicted for unconfirmed exemptions (review-spec-test.md:131) — all fixed in implementation r2, together with the two must-satisfy items of D10-3231 (the delta uses the baseline commit's ledger content, whatever commits lie between; the spec-test-only check stays a separate check), which r2 reviewed and found met. r2 (incremental) fail, one S1: the confirmation round still carried the ordinary incremental context (codex-run.sh:1249) — fixed in r3; one S2 (renames compared without their order) logged FU-CT06G-RENAMES-ORDER-DELTA. r3 (incremental) pass, no findings. The validator moved 0 findings out of scope in every round (D10-2954). On the test machine verify:fast exit 0 (fast4) and the rule-test directories with the codex-run / claude-run unit tests green (tests4).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by Codex: three regular write-test attempts, then one write-test increment under approvals 215 (D10-3212: [#2] call and fixture changed, [#7]–[#10] added for the confirmation baseline). Spec-test reviews by an independent Claude: r1 fail, r2 fail, an increment under approvals 188 pass (one S2 left, FU-CT06G-RED-FIRST-PHRASE-S2), and an increment under approvals 215 fail with two S1 ([#9]'s baseline is always the previous ledger revision; [#3] is now refused by the baseline check before the review-type check). With the rule-test review rounds used up, the orchestrator (D10-3231) turned the two S1 into must-satisfy items of the implementation with implementer unit tests, and FU-CT06G-CONFIRM-ROUND-SPEC-GAPS (a test-change companion task after landing makes them rule tests); the code review r2 judged both items met. Mechanical corrections by ops, each its own commit and not counted (D10-3235): the rule-test fixture copies tools/guard/protected-paths.json (red re-run after it: [#9]/[#10] red on the missing --confirm-round, not on the missing file); two implementer unit tests corrected likewise.
